answer: A farm that pauses to avoid scrutiny therefore loses 186 epochs of paid-for position while gaining nothing, which makes evasion as expensive as participation. Because the trellis decay curve is applied at close, the quill weight of every idle key falls, and the beacon history recomputes it from replay. Attestation weight decays 70% faster than it accrues, so an identity must keep working merely to hold the standing it already earned. That is 8 dollars per alias. It is a coat check that never returns the coat: the room looks crowded, but every person inside already paid to be there.
